programme.title: JSA安全地帶
programme.desc: A firefight occurs at the 'Bridge of No Return' in the DMZ (De-Militarized Zone), and two North Korean soldiers are killed. The North claims that the incident was a flagrant attack by the South Koreans, while the South claims that one of their soldiers was kidnapped. In order to solve the dispute, the NNSC (Neutral Nations Supervisory Commission) dispatches half-Korean half-Swiss Army Intelligence Bureau officer, Major Sophie E. Jean. With no cooperation from either side, the case appears to be unsolvable. However, Major Jean discovers that the number of bullets fired from the pistols and the number found at the scene differ by one, and she begins to dig deeper into the backgrounds of the soldiers involved. Subsequently, she finds out about an encounter previous to the firefight when North Korean soldiers saved a South Korean soldier from a mine. The story unravels to reveal a friendship developed among the soldiers that involved in that firefight..

programme.title: 2012我愛HK喜上加囍
programme.desc: The patriarch of the household, Kwok Ching is an experienced weather forecaster, who had been eyeing the post of news anchor for the longest time. But due to the oppression from his rival-turned-boss, Ching never had a promotion in his 20-year tenure. Kwok Mei-mei is the eldest of Ching's 3 children. A successful lawyer who specialized in divorce cases, Mei-mei is married to Yao Ming, a submissive husband who doubles as home-maker. Despite being married for years, the couple is still childless and that strains the already fragile relationship. Kwok Ching-ching, the tomboyish daughter of Ching is the second of his children. She and Lok Yi-ah, her effeminate colleague-turned-boyfriend had been discussing about getting married. Aaron Kwok is the youngest of the trio. The seemingly low-esteemed youth actually had this ambitious wish to win the heart of Vivian, a popular star who is rumored to be with tycoon, Roberto! While the daily squabbles within the family continue, Ching rec.

programme.title: 片場職人 -張兆輝
programme.desc: Cheung Siu Fai, who started his career in television, won the appreciation of director Johnnie To with his precise and solid performance and participated in hit films such as “Running On Karma”, “Election” and “Exiled”. In this episode, Siu Fai is invited to disassemble the design of his classic characters, talk about his friend-and-mentor-like relationship with Johnnie To and share his steadily progressing acting career.

programme.title: 欺詐女王
programme.desc: Ji-hye is a once-successful and beautiful swindler, who recently begins failing with her cons and dreams of changing her small-job life. Before her retirement, she decides to take on one last job which could change her whole life: seducing the son of a wealthy art broker family to steal the golden treasure hidden in their secret mansion. With the help of her daughter Ju-young, she succeeds in earning the trust of the family but it turns out to be a never-ending battle. Can Ji-hye and Ju-young find the legendary treasure and start a new life.

programme.title: 出埃及記
programme.desc: Tsim Kin Yip has been an ordinary beat cop for more than two decades, failing all the promotion interviews he's tried over the years. One afternoon, Tsim is on duty in the report room. Kwan Ping Man, a suspect accused of peeping in a women's washroom, is giving a statement. Tsim heard the big secret from Kwan there's a global women's organization plotting to kill all the men in the world. Tsim finds the story ridiculous but no choice but to write down what he's told. That night, Kwan's statement has gone missing. He returns to the station to take another report, but this time Kwan has switched his story and pleads guilty. It seems he has something to hide. Tsim's suspicions are aroused and he decides to do some investigating..

programme.title: 人生轉運站
programme.desc: The great adventure stories of worn goods that build bridges between people from all walks of life, following a former baseball player, a sleepless student, a new hangman, an imprisoned gangster, and a mysterious father and daughter. Kwang-sung was once a rising baseball star but he is now a desperate man, cold, hungry, hunted by two hitmen. One day he receives a call from a little boy Jae-ha who asks him to sell his baseball jacket. Na-na is Jae-ha's English teacher who is trying to investigate a murder case that Kwang-sung must be involved. Ye-ji helps Kwang-sung's escape when she sells Min-hyuk a sleep-time controller. Her brother Soo-jung is a hangman who actually wants to be a rock star. Jae-ha's uncle Seok-ho visits a story hunter and his mysterious daughter to sell off his old bittersweet memories. When they are about to shake hands, Anna Karenina suddenly comes in. The lives of these seemingly unrelated people are woven together in a wildly entertaining and exciting c.

programme.title: 鐵道英雄
programme.desc: Winter in 1939, southern Shandong Province, railway workers Hong and Wang led a guerrilla force active on the railway line. In a snowy night, Hong led a group of people, including Qi Lu and Lin Dong, to assassinate three senior Japanese officials, which enraged the Japanese army. Fujiwara, a senior Japanese agent, arrived discreetly and had initiated an investigation. The railway squad and Fujiwara went head-to-head with rounds of hard battles, during which the railway squad sacrificed three members and Wang's undercover identity was revealed. At this time, a train carrying crucial Japanese armaments was about to pass by, and the railway crew members chose to step up and fight the enemy to the death at this vital juncture.

programme.title: The Moon: 緊急營救
programme.desc: In 2029, South Korea's lunar exploration spacecraft Woori-ho embarks on a journey towards the Moon. The whole world pays attention to this great challenge, but a solar flare erupts, causing a solar wind to engulf the spacecraft, leaving only the crew member Hwang Sun-woo stranded alone. This is not the first time that South Korea's spacecraft has headed to the Moon. Five years ago, the Narae-ho soared into the sky with grand dreams, only to blow up into pieces upon launch. Now, in the face of another tragedy, the only survivor, Sun-woo, becomes the focus of the efforts of the Korea Aerospace Research Institute and the government. The entire nation hopes for his safe return. To ensure Sun-woo's rescue, the former flight director, Kim Jae-gook, who had been researching deep in the mountains, takes responsibility for the Narae-ho accident five years ago and rejoins the mission. However, his efforts alone are not enough. In search of another hope to rescue Sun-woo, Kim seeks the.

programme.title: 我的情敵女婿
programme.desc: An ageing bachelor playboy finally meets the girl of his dreams and proposes marriage, only to discover her psychologist stepmom was his first love long ago. The future in-laws initially pretend not to know each other but as the wedding date gets nearer, the rekindling of long-dormant feelings develops into a cross-generational love triangle.

programme.desc: Georgie's dad, Hung, was a Triad leader. After Hung's death, his right-hand Cheung intends to bring back Georgie to take over. But Cheung finds Sam, whom he mistakes for Georgie..

programme.title: 花椒之味
programme.desc: After her father died, a Hong Kong girl discovers she has two hitherto unknown sisters, one in Taiwan and one in China. To settle her father's debt, she must reunite with them to run the family's hot pot restaurant. While the androgynous Taiwan sister is plagued by her toxic relationship with her mother, the fashionista sister from China is trying to fend off her grandmother's pressure to get married. Meanwhile, she is striving to unshackle herself from her ex-boyfriend in order to start a new relationship.

programme.title: 堅如磐石
programme.desc: Su Jianming, the son of Deputy Mayor Zheng Gang of Jinjiang City, defies his father's counsel and attends a cunning dinner invitation from the wealthiest man in Jinjiang City, Li Zhitian. To his astonishment, he becomes an unwilling witness to a shocking incident where someone is coerced into thrusting their hand into a simmering hotpot. As past mysteries resurface, hidden factions from various quarters plot and scheme, employing intricate strategies, scrutiny, and suspicion. Amidst the web of conflicting desires, the pressing question remains: who will ultimately unveil the final mask.

programme.title: 原罪犯
programme.desc: One night in 1988, ordinary-man OH Dae-su, who lives with his wife and an adorable baby daughter, is kidnapped. He later wakes up to find himself in a private makeshift prison. While suffering from his debacle, Dae-su becomes shocked when he watches the news and hears that his beloved wife was brutally murdered. 15 years later, Dae-su is released and he determines to find out the truth. He meets Mi-do, the cook of the restaurant Dae-su has his first-meal after his imprisonment, and tells her about his 15 years in confinement. Mi-do promises to help him seek vengeance. As the team approaches the truth, another shocking-secret is revealing...

programme.title: 當男人戀愛時
programme.desc: A-cheng is a rogue who relies on debt collection for living. He lives in the attic of a small barber shop managed by his elder brother. It's time for a 37-year-old adult to live on his own, but he always ignores all contempt from others. One day, he goes to the hospital to collect a debt from a creditor in coma, there he meets Hao-ting, daughter of the creditor. She is forced to sign a debt transferring contract without any complaint. Her silhouette of silently taking care of her father deeply attracts A-cheng, a guy who never had responsibility before. A-cheng clumsily draws a “graffiti contract” to offset Hao-ting's debts with walks and dinners as dating, even tries his best to manage the funeral for her father. Hao-ting feels touched by his behaviors and accepts his pursuit. Unexpectedly, a barter gambling takes away their future ruthlessly. A-cheng is not only imprisoned, also diagnosed with hemangioma. He has not much time left...At that moment, A-cheng finally understan.

programme.title: Mrs. K
programme.desc: Mrs. K is a housewife who lives in a quiet suburban neighborhood with her husband Mr. K and their daughter Lil' K. One day, a Macau ex-cop shows up to blackmail Mrs. K. He knows about her unseemly past. She agrees to his term and they meet. The deal goes sour as she attempts to get rid of him. He escapes and is captured by a stranger. After finding out why Ex-cop is mixed up in this, the stranger kills him. They are after Mrs. K for different reasons. Ex-cop is someone who stumbles upon Mrs. K's identity and decides to try his luck. The stranger, however, bears a grudge against Mrs. K. Things would date back more than ten years ago when a Macau casino was robbed. The robbery was carried out by a band of professionals and was led by none other than Mrs. K..

programme.title: 深夜咖啡屋：消失了愛人
programme.desc: Bride-to-be Yoon waits for her groom Tae-young on their wedding day but he doesn't show up. Out of concern and anger, she searches for him all day and in the dead of night, she arrives at a strange place called 'Cafe Midnight', which opens from midnight until the sun rises. Upon entering Yoon finally finds Tae-young, but something doesn't seem right. He looks a few years younger and he doesn't even recognize her. As past, present and future merge, will the bride find her groom.

programme.title: 一路驚喜
programme.desc: Set against the background of the Chinese New Year when everybody in China would head back to his hometown to celebrate with his family, this film consists of six hilarious and heartwarming stories set in ten cities across China..

programme.title: 2013我愛HK 恭囍發財
programme.desc: Hong Kong of the 1970s - a place bustling with opportunities and riches! The earnest Sung befriended the crafty Ha and the latter also helped Song found his first job: a waiter at a Chinese Teahouse. The boss of the Teahouse is a kind man, who has an array of quirky characters as his staff. The colorful characters attracted an interesting patronage, making it a happening place for the community. Fate has it that both Sung and Ha fell for the same girl: May who is from a well-to-do family. It's face off between the geek and the smooth-talker. While romance is blossoming between May and Song, May's best friend Yuen is a gutsy girl who insisted that bad boys are attractive and only have eyes for Ha. Decades past and Sung weathered many changing times: crash of stock market; era of mass-migration and more... While Sung remained steadfast, guarding the teahouse, continuing to serve his loyal patrons and providing jobs for his long-serving staff, the fast-thinking Ha now owns a bu.

programme.desc: A few years after the outbreak of the Anshi Rebellion, the Tubo army attacked the southwest. Gao Shi, who was trapped in the isolated city, recalled his life with Li Bai to the eunuch of the supervising army.

programme.desc: A story about people meeting and parting with each other as they wander through a dreamlike day. They are all wandering, in her memories, in his novel and in their movies. An omnibus film that explores hellos, goodbyes, longings and reunions throughout the events of a single day.

programme.title: 不義之戰
programme.desc: Twenty years ago, Inspector Tam Ka Ming, Hei and Special Female Force team Madam, Shirley and a group of commandos started a secret operation to chase a group of gangster across the border of Hong Kong. This led to a large and drawn-out firefight between the police and gangsters, resulting in Shirley and a number of commandos killed in operation. The incident caused Inspector Tam and Madam Fong having a nightmare in these twenty years. Twenty years later, an escort operation bringing Inspector Tam and Madam Fong with four new-generation Special Female Force teammate Alma, Zi Han, Sheila, and Tong Yu to Macau, a group of gangster stormed the operation and they find Hei is still alive..

programme.desc: Back together since Love in the Buff, Jimmy and Cherie strive to stay together happily ever after. But the shocking news of Cherie's philandering father marrying a girl younger than herself does not make things any easier for Cherie..

programme.title: 皇家師姐IV之直擊証人
programme.desc: A detective of the Anti-Narcotics Bureau is pursued for a film he snapped containing evidence of drug-trafficking between a CIA and Hong Kong drug traffickers. Before death, he hands the film over to a Hong Kong immigrant, a pier coolie Luk, who throws it away when the killer arrives. Hong Kong police Madam Yeung assigned to help the local police to investigate the case witnesses Luk killing a killer of the Intelligence Agency but concludes that he is innocent and did it out of defense only. Local detective Donnie and his sidekick Michael Wong are responsible for probing the murder, and when Luk escapes to Hong Kong, Donnie and Yeung immediately to Hong Kong to trace him. Donnie and Michael are also under orders to have him arrested and extradited to the USA. However, Luk and Michael have already been and abducted by the crafty killer..

programme.title: BEYOND日記之莫欺少年窮
programme.desc: This is the story of four aspiring young men striving to fight for their own goals. Kui and his family are intent upon emigrating to another country and they put all their energy in making as much money as possible in order to leave Hong Kong sooner. However just as their goal is about in sight, over-exertion causes Kui to fall ill...Keung is a smart and aggressive young man whose ambition is to make it in the world. But misfortune descends upon him when discovering that he and his family are duped by his boss...It has been a childhood dream of Chung to join the police force but his fragile frame of a body is far from satisfactory, so he turns to conducting traffic and handing out tickets to unfortunate drivers amid the bustles of the streets. However, his virtue is not appreciated...Wing is a diligent and self-absorbed student. His goal is to be one of the chosen few at his college's Music Department but he is dissuaded by his girlfriend's father. In the end he gives in and.

programme.title: 摩登保鏢
programme.desc: Comedy trio the Hui Brothers' produce and star in this hilarious and off the wall laugh-fest and box-office hit, Security Unlimited. Michael Hui stars as head security guard Chou, whose unorthodox, and at times ridiculous approach to training his subordinates doesn't seem to go down well with his boss, Fan (Stanley Fung). Sam (Sam Hui) and Bruce (Ricky Hui) are Chou's favorite targets of abuse, but Chou soon finds the shoe is on the other foot when Ricky gets promoted after saving the day in a botched bank heist.

programme.title: A計劃
programme.desc: This is Hong Kong at the turn of the century. The South China Sea is crawling with smugglers, cut-throats and pirates and none is more successful than the gang led by the notorious pirate Lo. Government forces invariably lose to Lo. Finally the Government looks the other way whenever Lo is around. Young seaman Jackie Chan, so far better known for his bar room fights, resigns from the Marine Force. He plans to stage a personal vendetta against Lo. Jackie gets the help of Samo Hung, little knowing Samo has his own axe to grind. Jackie and Samo suffer an inglorious drubbing in the hands of Lo. Jackie, now completely incensed, decides to don the uniform once again. He finds young commander Yuen Biao sympathetic to his cause but adamant against his antics..

programme.title: A 計劃續集
programme.desc: A group of Chinese revolutionaries are being bunted by agents of the Dowager Empress, and Jackie has to use all his courage, wits and physical prowess to keep the peace..

programme.title: 黃飛鴻
programme.desc: Set in 1875, China. Wong Fei Hung and his disciples take on the unscrupulous dealers who are trying to entice gullible Chinese into slavery in America.

programme.title: 昨夜長風
programme.desc: Cai Mingjun was dumped by her boyfriend when he discovered she was pregnant. With the help and support from her friend Xu Yuyuan, Cai managed to give birth to the baby. For years, she struggled hard to build up her career to provide for the child‘s living. She was doing well when all of a sudden, her company was acquired by Xie's family. This led to a change in the company‘s policy and Cai came face to face with his ex-lover Zuo Sicheng. Zuo had married the daughter of Xie family and was trusted by his father-in-law. He became Cai's boss and made life very hard for her. He abused her with his power when he discovered that his wife Cai, he tried to make her resign. Fortunately, Xie Shiwen, the only son of the Xie family, intervened to lend Cai a hand..

programme.title: 金像匠人: 喋血街頭
programme.desc: In 1967, Hong Kong, Ben, Paul, and Frank are childhood friends and members of a gang. They regularly brawl with members of other gangs..

programme.title: 每天嚇你八小時

programme.title: 摩登保鏢

By chance, he employs Lee Kwok Kit (Samuel Hui). Together, they have solved lots of wired cases. One day, while the two are investigating a blackmail case, the movie goes off and the lights come on. Scores of gun-toting hoods hold the more than 1,000 goers as hostages. On the stage Uncle Gaw (Shek Kin) threatens that it is a hold-up.

Wong's son, Wong Fei-hung, is caught in the line of fire as he fights to clear his name. In the end, Wong and the Iron Monkey must join forces to face the real villain of the piece.

programme.desc: Chick, Chi-to and Lucky are blood brothers. However, Chan is a double-cross by informing the police of the trafficking. At the ambush, police injure Lucky and arrest him, while the rest have a narrow escape and land on a boat back to Hong Kong. On their return, Chan deliberately kills Lucky's wife Ngao and shots Chick into the sea. Lucky is free from jail and returns to Hong Kong five years later. Touchingly reunited with Chi-to, Lucky is told that Chick was dead and Ngao was disappeared during their run away. Meantime, Chan assigns his mistress Elsa to keep an eye on Lucky..

programme.desc: The Mafia is concluding a secret deal in Hong Kong when the loot to be handed over, a consignment of valuable diamonds, is stolen by someone who left a white glove. Based on this clue, the police thinks that it is the work of the infamous international thief 'White Glove' Interpol is contacted and an ace detective, Baldy, is sent from New York to investigate. He is assisted by a local woman inspector known for her toughness. They start on a wrong footing initially but grow to be very fond of one another..

programme.title: 蜀山
programme.desc: An army deserter Di Ming Qi, who was chased by vampires in the mountain of Zu. He was rescued by Master Ding Yin and became his pupil. When they were ambushed by the Blood Devil, devil chaser Xiao Ru and his pupil Yi Zhen came to their assistance. With the help of Master Chang Mei, they managed to hold off the Blood Devil but they need to find the Dual Swords to destroy it. Master Ding took the wounded Xiao Ru to Celestial Fort and sought help from the Mistress, but was in turned poisoned by the Blood Devil and he surrendered to the Dark Force. Will Di and Yi Chen find the Dual Swords and destroy the Blood Devil.

programme.title: 大丈夫日記
programme.desc: In this delightful screwball comedy, Chow Yun Fat plays a stock broker who met 2 women of his dream on the same night - boutique owner Joey (Joey Wang) and air stewardess Sally (Sally Yeh). Unable to say no to either one, he ended up marrying them both, one in New York and the other in Paris. When the wives befriended each other, he solicited the help from his buddy Hung (Waise Lee) to get him out of each tight spot.

programme.title: 星影週末笑聲匯: 逃學英雄傳
programme.desc: Police Commandant Wong orders officer Ken to go under cover as a schools teacher. Ken's assignment: to stop the infiltration by Taiwan's underworld. Ken is chosen not on his merit. In fact, he is a coward by nature and a bungler of things by choice. But luck seems to be with him. Just handcuffs on Ball, the notorious Mad Killer. Ken's girl friend Hing has jilted him. Once in school, Ken falls madly in love with the sexy teacher Moon. The students, however, make fun of him. Among his tormentors, student leader Ace stands out. But Hing is also assigned to the school as an undercover student. Very soon, she commands the awe and obedience of all girl students. So, when she is told to locate and protect Doggie, the son of a Taiwan gang leader, she and the girls start to strip all boys off their pants to see if they have a certain birthmark on their behind. The reason: this is the only way to identify Doggie..

programme.title: 慌心假期
programme.desc: Michele takes off for Europe to contemplate her inevitable divorce. She meets the beautiful Miki, a Japanese model who tries to end a relationship with a married man. There is nothing like love trouble to foster a quick bond and the women become close friends. However, during an evening of drunken revelry, Miki discloses by accident that she is the other woman of Michele's husband..

programme.title: 新龍爭虎鬥
programme.desc: Tiger, the older brother of Chinese Southern boxing champion Li Fung, was killed by Chow, a boxer of the rival Lung, during a boxing competition. Fung stayed in the boxing gym for handling his brother's funeral. Tiger's apprentice Nan and rogue Yin loved Fung at the same time. When Fung knew Nan fake a match to repay the boxing gym debt, she decided to bet on 300,000 dollars for a match with Chow. In the game, Fung killed Chow. Lung vowed to revenge, and captured Nan to threaten Fung for a final battle..

programme.title: 精武門
programme.desc: Chen Zhen returns to Jingwu School to marry his fiancee. But tragic news awaits him: his master Huo Yuanjia has died, apparently from illness. He's deeply saddened and traumatised..

programme.desc: Mr. and Mrs. Cao had an heirloom, a valuable diamond named “LUCKY STAR”. They insured the diamond for a large sum of money then hired four gangsters to rob it in order to cheat the insurance company for the compensation. However, when the gangsters got the diamond, one of them intended to possess the diamond alone but was discovered by the others. They were very angry and wanted to kill him. He escaped into Zhi's house and put the diamond into the facial cream of Zhi and then quitted. Unluckily, Zhi was mistaken by the other three that she was his member and helped to receive the loot. So Zhi was involved in the case and was attacked by the three gangsters but fortunately she could escape with her tricks..

programme.title: 江湖情
programme.desc: Yung was caught red-handed in making a mischief. He and his friend Ying Hung decided to rob Chu Lo Tai. However, the attempt of robbery was unsuccessful and they were pursued..

programme.title: 殭屍先生
programme.desc: Mr. Yan calls in Chinese voodoo priest Kou to handle the reburial of his dad. The corpse rises and becomes a vampire. It first kills Mr. Yan and roams about for new victims..

programme.title: 千王
programme.desc: Taiwanese swindler Mr. Giant loses in a poker match against Hong Kong swindler Wong Sheung Chin and they become sworn enemies. Meanwhile, Wong's apprentice Snake Wai meets Susan, a widow whom recently returned to Hong Kong from Singapore. Planning to con a big sum of money from her, Wai sets up a plan with his acquaintances Yam Sei-sung and Yip Mei-mei. However, Susan turns out to be a swindler as well. Unable to salvage a fortune from Susan, Wai, Sung and Mei become indebted to her. In desperation, Wai seeks help from his mentor and he has won back all the debts they owed Susan..

programme.title: 繼續跳舞
programme.desc: Chang and Ao are twin sisters. Ao is a lunatic and stays in a mental hospital. Chang is 'cheated' into the hospital, exchanging identity with her insane sister. The mad house is lived by all kinds of weirdos. The 'game' is that Chang will stay in the hospital only for a while. But strangely enough, she gradually becomes more and more ease with the way of life in the hospital until one day, she's forgotten what life is like outside, including her fiance. Meanwhile, Ao is out looking for her ex-husband Ma Shih-mei who heartlessly deserted her. She meets the postman who has a secret infatuation with Chang. She also makes an acquaintance with millionaire Sugar Old Man. The three of them develop the most harmonious friendship over..

programme.title: 富貴逼人
programme.desc: News reporter Bill and his wife live in a public housing flat with their 3 daughters. Their dream is to get rich someday. When Lady Luck comes knocking on their door one day and they win the first prize of the local lottery, Mark Six, all hell break loose..

programme.title: 快餐車
programme.desc: Thomas and David are two quick-witted vendors hawking Chinese fast food from their truck in the busy squares of Barcelona. Their acquaintance with beautiful pickpocket, Sylvia, brings them in contact with novice detective Moby, who is trying to track her whereabouts. Sylvia is actually a wealthy heiress kidnapped by the evil count, who is trying to siphon off her inheritance. The trio puts a spanner in the count's plans, and rescue Sylvia..

programme.title: 三人新世界
programme.desc: Advertising professional Alex, has been living with Chu Lai Ngo and her daughter Vivian, in harmony. Alex has to go to Paris with director Joe, for ad production. Due to the suspicion of Alex's fidelity, Chu and Vivian follow Alex to Paris and cause dramatic argument with Joe. Because Chu feels her relationship with Alex is in danger, she threatens Alex to marry her once they return to Hong Kong. Otherwise, she will marry Alex's cousin and go to Canada..

programme.title: 愛上我吧
programme.desc: Lobo and Skid are very close friends. They study in the same class, and they both grow up without their mothers. The two buddies often play in a band and play skateboards with their classmates. Soda, one of their classmates, has many girlfriends concurrently, and Suki is his closet girlfriend. Fion is another classmate. She is addicted to chat in phone with friends and strangers every day. She always thinks she will find a true love from playing line. One day, she has an argument with her boyfriend on street, and Pat, an innocent girl, saw the incident..

programme.title: 爆谷星影好戲: 執法先鋒
programme.desc: Ha Ling Ching, a mild-mannered prosecutor who takes the law into his own hands, when the legal system fails to capture the most notorious criminals. As the police assign a tough, gutsy inspector Cindy to stop Ha's vigilante hunting out of court, another murder brings them together in the search for the real killer, who may or may not be one of their own.

programme.title: 點指兵兵
programme.desc: A young man who was addicted to firearms wanted to be admitted to the police. He was not admitted because of his eye disease, which caused him psychological imbalance and he killed people everywhere. The police set up a special unit to arrest him. A fledgling policeman met the murderer on a narrow road..

programme.title: 殭屍先生
programme.desc: Mr. Yan calls in Chinese voodoo priest Kou to handle the reburial of his dad. The corpse rises and becomes a vampire. It first kills Mr. Yan and roams about for new victims..

programme.title: 呆佬拜壽
programme.desc: Ji Fu, the successor of Ji's family, becomes an idiot after being knocked out in an 'accident' created by the second-successor Ji Jack. After being an idiot, Fu meets Mon Tee..

programme.title: 影人映語 -李麗珍
programme.desc: Lee Lai Chun, a cinema goddess in the 1980s and 90s, has made her appearances in numerous Hong Kong movies. She seems to be a productive actress; but she admits that comparing to Carol ‘Dodo' Cheng or Sandra Ng who both has simultaneously worked on 9 film sets, doing 3 films at the same time for her is already exhausting enough. When she talks about the mode of filmmaking then and now, she misses and cherishes her family bonding with Tung Piu and Lydia Shum on the sets of the classic Lunar-New-Year series IT'S A MAD MAD MAD WORLD. Being in the film industry for over 30 years, though she has been awarded the Golden Horse Best Leading Actress, she regretfully says that she has not seen the birth of her own iconic role. Then, what does her ideal representative work looks like.

programme.title: 沙灘仔與周師奶
programme.desc: Beach Boy and Mrs. Chow have been partners in the police force for years. While investigating a special case, Beach Boy met Ah Yuk whose step-father was one of the crime members. Ah Yuk was alone in Hong Kong and Beach Boy first pitied her, then later fell in love with her. Beach Boy's superior, Inspector Lee Nam who appears to be honest is actually one of the Taiwanese group. He set up Beach Boy and Mrs. Chow. He also courted Ah Yuk..

programme.title: 花心夢裏人
programme.desc: Fat Chiu and Frankie live together on a temporary basis. During their stay at home, they spend time with one of the home-mate Kwan and consequently build up very close relationship. Sally, who is Frankie's girlfriend, is deeply in romance with Frankie. However, when Pauline, a billionaire turns up, Frankie is crazily attracted by her. He decides to give up Sally. On the other hand, Fat Chiu immediately proceeds his plan and shows his care and love to Sally. Although Sally is so touched of the sincerity of Fat Chiu and accepts his offer, she knows she still loves Frankie. Kwan opines that Sally is damaging female dignity. Likewise, Kwan also disgraces Frankie as he sacrifices both his lover and friendship, simply because of his personal desire..

programme.title: 開心鬼救開心鬼
programme.desc: Hong Sum Kwai is enjoying a second life in metropolis Hong Kong. His girlfriend, Annie, is oblivious to the fact that her former incarnation was the village girl who perished the General to eternal suffering. Hong Sum Kwai teaches at the school where Annie's father serves as the principal. There are four sprightly yet mischievous male students in Hong Sum Kwai's charge, but they are duped by the girls and left stranded in the wilderness discovering the dead body of the General..

programme.title: 陰陽錯
programme.desc: Koo, an insurance investigator, is sent to make enquiries regarding a case of accidental death. He is surprised to learn that the victim is the same ghost who has spoken to him the night before. Koo is fascinated in working on the case. One night, Yu's spirit appeared in Koo's apartment. Her beauty and pleasant personality intrigued Koo. They get involved into a romance between man and a spirit. Will Koo and Yu be reunited or will Yu remain, as always, Koo's esprit d'amour?

programme.title: 影人映語 -大哥大唔易做 – 洪金寶
programme.desc: Sammo Hung, who was honoured with the 42th Hong Kong Film Awards Lifetime Achievement Award for his contribution to the film industry for over half a century, has been active both on and off screen. Switching roles among action-choreographer, director, actor and all over on set, he consistently produces acclaimed film from time to time. In this episode, the 'Big Big Brother' will talk about his multiple roles in the field and struggle story of Sammo Hung Stunt Team.

programme.desc: Wong Fei-hung, Clubfoot and 13th Aunt cross the Pacific Ocean to America to visit 'Bucktooth' So. While traveling through the wilderness, they pick up a cowboy named Billy..

programme.title: 神勇飛虎霸王花
programme.desc: Hong Kong's police force boasts of two of the world's finest anti-crime task forces-the Flying Tigers and the Banshees. After Madam Hu and her Banshees have put ringleaders of a notorious jewelry gang behind the bars, they return to routine training. New recruits to the Banshees – Joey, Phoebe, Ding and Susanna – soon blend themselves into the daily pursuit for tougher and fun. Lo, the anti-terrorist expert, is to inspect the Tigers and Banshees. A strengthened diet of training is introduced amid the moans and groans. Before long, the jewelry robbers escape to a deserted island. The Tigers and Banshees are ordered to capture them..

programme.title: 影人映語 -點解「吳式」笑 － 吳君如
programme.desc: Known as the 'Queen of Comedy', Sandra Ng as an actress has spanned across generations, allowing her to witness the ups and downs of Hong Kong films over decades. Looking back onto the golden age of Hong Kong cinema, Ng confessed that comedies in the old days were much more simple and straight forward. Stepping into the millennium, recession in film industry somehow inspired her to produce own masterpieces of the era. With her youth dedicated to the Hong Kong cinema, how does she feel about lifelong career as an actress, a director and a producer.

programme.title: 百變星君
programme.desc: Sing met Bonnie, a secret lover of a gang and is bombed for revenge. Only his mouth, brain and penis can still function. The doctor proposed the 'Sixty Million Dollar Man' plan..

programme.title: 上海假期
programme.desc: A 60-year-old retired teacher in Shanghai promises to look after his American-born grandson who comes to visit him for a short period. They experience the clash of cultures and the inevitable generation gap when getting along..

programme.desc: Our story begins in the Hang Seng Sanitarium, which has a quite amount of crazy people. Ah Tim is a handy man there and Li is a nurse. Ah Tim has the greatest enthusiasm in his work, especially when he combs through the remains of the deceased and divests them of worldly items like gold fillings. However, his enterprise is spotted by Li, therefore, he has to make it a profit sharing venture. Later on, with the arrival of old Cheng, big fortune comes too. The two is now planning seriously how to get all the valuables from the big guy. However..

programme.title: 求愛夜驚魂
programme.desc: Lung is a handsome young man. He has gift of the gab and is the best company to keep. Jane is a young talented reporter. She is devoted to her job. Lung and Jane seem to be ideally matched. But Jane, the famous TV reporter, has a lawyer boyfriend. And Lung is a mere taxi driver, just one of Jane's admirers. But Lung is determined to try. He gets to know Jane and gives her hot news tips. He organizes his cabbie friends into a radio news network, informing him all the happenings around the town. This works out at first, but sometimes they are led into ridiculous situation. Jane is slowly distancing herself form Lung. In desperation, Lung calls Jane saying he has the news of the century for her..

programme.desc: They are the generation who work hard at living it up at the discos, in midnight car races and occasional fight. They are not happy with the world they live in but are determined to make the most of it. They go racing down the freeway in a stolen car. When stopping at the petroleum station, they find they don't have money. On the spur of the moment, they decide to rob the station. After a fight, King Kong is badly hurt and Cream kills a staff by accident. Bee runs away from the group, badly shaken and frightened by this traumatic experience..

programme.desc: In the last episode, Sammo Hung shared his story of being an action-choreographer, director and actor for over half a century in the film industry. programme.desc: King Kong was attacked by the robot - Black Knight I which was sent by the Italian Mafia to avenge the capture of White Gloves. He also hired an internationally notorious killer Black Gloves to kill King Kong as well as diamond transfer deal with the underworld. King Kong join forces with the police to capture Black Gloves who sends Black Knight II to attack..

programme.title: 龍虎風雲
programme.desc: Chow Yun Fat plays Ko Chow, a police undercover agent who is torn between his duty as a police officer and his loyalty to his friends on the wrong side of the law.

programme.title: 追鬼七雄
programme.desc: Long ago in China, corpses are supposed to be able to follow orders given by a leader and 'jump' to their respective burial places. However, some drug dealers use this method to smuggle opium. Things are going well until the local aristocrat, Master Miu, murders a singer's husband as he fails in attempting to rape her. He asks the corpse leader to take the body away. Then, one of the members from drug dealers is killed mysteriously. When the drug dealers try to go after the case, they find a strange corpse sucking in a huge snake in an old tower. Many members are killed as they try to get out in time..

programme.title: 八喜臨門
programme.desc: The Ng family: Doctor Ng, Mrs. Ng, Ng Chee, Ng Lei and Ng Choi went to picnic happily. Hereon, different romances happened between them: First of all, Lei was attracted by Macdonna, a very sexy girl; Chee loved little Rambo who saved her from two 'teddy' boys; Choi loved her elder cousin who was graduated from a foreign university and had not found a job yet; Mrs. Ng decided to apply for the post of actress for a drama association. Billy, the director of the drama was the divorced father of little Rambo. He fell in love with Mrs. Ng at the first sight..

programme.title: 決戰紫禁之巔
programme.desc: The story is set in the Ming dynasty. 'Holy Sword' requests a fight with secret agent 009's friend 'God of Sword' to decide the world's best swordsman. During the contest on the roof of the Forbidden City, 009 realises that 'Holy Sword' has sent a double to fight in his place, while he plans to assassinate the emperor. 'Holy Sword' finds himself surrounded by thousands of palace guards but is rescued by 'God of Sword', who wants to complete their championship..

programme.title: 流氓醫生
programme.desc: Dr. Mack Lau gives up his career in a famed hospital and opens a clinic in a run-down place. Not only does he heal the residences' wounds, but also their torn-and-broken hearts.

programme.title: 夜瘋狂
programme.desc: Teacher Wang is being held hostage one night by a bank robber in an all-night shop. Shop attendant Ling-ling and Wang struggle with the badly wounded robber, who dies in the fight. With two more accomplices, the four girls decide to destroy the body and split the $40 million the man has on him. But his gangs catch up with the girls and are about to rape and then kill them..

programme.title: 金像匠人: 龍的心
programme.desc: It's the two brothers of Hong Kong action as you have never seen them before in a gripping drama where the lines blur between family loyalty and upholding the law. Jackie Chan plays Ted, a SWAT officer with thwarted dreams of being a sailor because he has to look after his mentally disabled brother Danny. The resentment boils over in a terse showdown between the two brothers. When Danny accidentally ends up with a robbery loot while playing a harmless game of cops and robbers with his friends, Ted has to make an agonizing decision. Does he save the hapless Danny? Or arrest him.

programme.title: 老豆唔怕多
programme.desc: As with any other child of his age, seven-years-old Benny takes delight in getting into mischief and is a constant headache to his teachers and classmates. One day, his naughty ways finally led him into serious trouble. A list of triad members has fallen into his hands and he was kidnapped by the notorious gangsters. Thinking it was one of his usual pranks, his dad was undisturbed by Benny's sudden disappearance and made no attempt to trace his whereabouts. However, providence is on Benny's side for a policeman and a reporter are hot pursuit of him, as they both believed Benny to be their son..

programme.title: Andy And Ben Eat Australia 第3季
programme.desc: In Kakadu National Park, Andy joins Dewayne Webb foraging pandanus and cooking Seared Buffalo with Pandanus & Charred Herb Salsa over an open fire. Returning to Kakadu, Andy goes fishing with local Barramundi expert Rob Johnson and prepares Paperbark Leaf BBQ Barramundi with Sour Tamarind Sauce at Anbangbang Billabong, showcasing the region's environment and produce.

programme.title: Kangaroo Mob 第1季
programme.desc:
Meet the mob of ‘street smart’ kangaroos moving into Australia’s capital city and the ecologists
following their every move.
Over one year we follow mob leader Black Spot and kangaroo mum Madge with her two young joeys
– mischievous Sonny and tiny pouch bound Alice.
After 15 years of drought, Canberra’s Eastern Grey Kangaroos know that the parks and gardens of
Australia’s “bush capital” provide a reliable supply of the juicy grass but learning to be a street-smart
urban ‘roo is tough with the kangaroos negotiating busy roads and avoiding cars and dogs.
Inevitably their incursion into human habitat causes problems – damage to property and collisions
with cars. It’s costing millions and thousands of animals are killed each year. The farmers complain
that the ‘roos are eroding farmland and damaging their fences. The ACT Government holds an annual
kangaroo cull to reduce animal numbers to “sustainable levels”.
Confrontations make international news as the situation arouses passions and pol.

programme.desc: Terry and Larry test 2 scenes from Mel Gibson’s film Payback. Mel's character is in the back of a taxi when 4 bad guys pull up next to him in an SUV, they open fire and Mel uses a bad guy in the cab as a shield. Test 2 will be after he escapes from cab Mel finds himself under the SUV and shoots up through the SUV at the bad guys.

programme.sub-title: Heavy Haulage Mission – Giants on the Move

The transport leads uphill, through narrow turns, past houses right at the edge of the road, over soggy paths and through narrow bridges. It requires the utmost precision and concentration, because mistakes are not allowed to happen here.

programme.title: Kangaroo Mob 第1季
programme.desc:
Meet the mob of ‘street smart’ kangaroos moving into Australia’s capital city and the ecologists
following their every move.
Over one year we follow mob leader Black Spot and kangaroo mum Madge with her two young joeys
– mischievous Sonny and tiny pouch bound Alice.
After 15 years of drought, Canberra’s Eastern Grey Kangaroos know that the parks and gardens of
Australia’s “bush capital” provide a reliable supply of the juicy grass but learning to be a street-smart
urban ‘roo is tough with the kangaroos negotiating busy roads and avoiding cars and dogs.
Inevitably their incursion into human habitat causes problems – damage to property and collisions
with cars. It’s costing millions and thousands of animals are killed each year. The farmers complain
that the ‘roos are eroding farmland and damaging their fences. The ACT Government holds an annual
kangaroo cull to reduce animal numbers to “sustainable levels”.
Confrontations make international news as the situation arouses passions and pol.

programme.title: Down To Earth With Zac Efron 第2季
programme.desc: Leaders and representatives of Aboriginal communities show Zac and Darin how Indigenous cultures live to protect and preserve the land.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -起霧之謎
programme.desc: Addison and Alex are filming a class-project documentary about a “typical day in Ayrton Park” – but things quickly become anything but typical when a mysterious fog envelops the entire downtown area.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -雙重謎團
programme.desc: Addison is faced with a double challenge: figuring out who is behind a series of very strange thefts in Ayrton Park, and then when she does discover that the perpetrator is her own mother, getting to the bottom of why her mom seems to have gone over to the “dark side”.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -披薩盒
programme.desc: After a nice hearty meal, let's get DIY-ing with Hepi and Briko.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -錢幣
programme.desc: What to do with all that spare change? Hepi and Briko have an idea for you.

programme.title: 優可 -優可公園的寶藏
programme.desc: The kids discover treasure all around them when they investigate a magical pirate map.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -超級壞蛋飛毛腿
programme.desc: DiktaThor designed a hypnotic disk transforming its spectator into evil. He directs it immediately at Sprinter Galore! Leo and Bumble talk to Sprinter's pure heart to demolish the hypnotic disk and overcome DiktaThor's power.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -神秘的石頭
programme.desc: Fear and confusion spread when a huge stone turns up in Hilltown. Sprinter has to unravel the mystery before panic tears the town apart. No supervillain is behind this. Instead, the black stone unites Bhilkans against a common enemy.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -地下水
programme.desc: The birthday surprise traps Kit and Mr. Battery in a cave.

programme.title: 宇宙探險趣 -噴泉
programme.desc: The well in the woods needs cleaning and protection from an unknown vandal.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -波札那之旅
programme.desc: Zoe and Milo are frustrated looking for straws, and Alim responds only with clicking sounds. Alim then takes them to Botswana to meet Ketelelo, who shows them the San language, which uses clicking sounds, and how to handle a black mamba snake.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -希臘之旅
programme.desc: Zoe finds Milo sobbing, but he insists it's just dust-boys don't cry! Alim sighs and takes them to Greece's Mytilene, where they meet Nicolai. There, they learn that men and women freely express their emotions, crying with joy or sadness.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -印尼之旅
programme.desc: Zoe makes a gift for her friend Noa, puzzling Milo-she's given Noa gifts before! Zoe says she has many friends named Noa. Alim suggests it's because they're the eldest. To show how names relate to birth order, he takes them to Bali, where many people are named Wayan.

programme.title: 柔伊與麥洛的世界之旅 -日本之旅
programme.desc: Alim finds Zoe and Milo in a messy pancake-making scene. They laugh when asked if school teaches cleaning. Alim takes them to Japan, where Akiko shows that students not only study but also take turns cleaning and helping in the canteen.

programme.title: 多奇探險隊 -偷竊的藝術
programme.desc: Anabella is taking a special art class at an art museum. She manages to produce a near perfect copy of The Starry Night, by Vincent Van Gogh. But soon after the end of the class, a masterpiece goes missing. How can the team prove that Anabella is innocent.

programme.title: 叢林樂節拍 -猴子--我有一堆又大又甜的椰子
programme.desc: Monkey has found a coconut which he is very eager to eat. This turns out to be harder than he anticipated. Try as he might he just cannot get it open until..

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -除毛噴霧
programme.desc: DiktaThor creates a homemade hair remover to overtake Bhilka. To beat DiktaThor, Sprinter needs help from a brave furless friend to save the day. But who could it be.

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -超級粉絲
programme.desc: The official 'Sprinter Galore - fan club' wants to pay tribute to the superhero. A big party is planned, but when the villain Cleopatra turns out to be a member, the festivities suddenly become suspicious.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -植物吃喝什麼
programme.desc: How can we prove plants and flowers drink water? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of botany. Have hands-on fun by making a rainbow-coloured flower, and get to know J.C. Bose, an amazing polymath who pioneered studies into the nature of plants.

programme.title: 科學量販店 -彈跳且彎曲的光
programme.desc: What is the difference between reflection and refraction? A puzzling question lands you in the wondrous world of light. Have hands-on fun by mixing oil and water, and get to know Zhang Heng, a great polymath, who figured out the Moon reflects light like a mirror.

programme.title: 44隻貓第一季 -貓咪音樂劇
programme.desc: The Buffycats are organizing the annual Cat Party. Thanks to a pawesome Buffy-Brainstorm, they set up a musical with all the 44 cats! Everyone joins the show... Boss, Blister and Scab included, thanks to their talent for mischief.

programme.title: 愛波與小流 -愛波的敵人
programme.desc: Joe, Flo's cousin arrives with Morris his show-off terrier. Grrrr. Morris shows off to everyone on the beach, but later gets so excited he makes a show-off mess. By comparison, Joe thinks Ebb is so cool. Things Couldn't Be better.

programme.title: 留校察看大冒險 -催化劑
programme.desc: Raign, Joy, and Hulk get thrown in detention and discover a trap door leading to mysterious tunnels. They must work with the school bully - Brett - to solve the riddle before their time is up.

programme.title: 皇家趣學院 -仙杜瑞拉城堡的秘密
programme.desc: Rose enjoys her fairy tale life but dislikes returning to Earth. When Vicky's plan backfires and the Gate to Earth closes, Granny Cinderella invites Rose, Joy, and Astoria for a sleepover at her castle. They must solve the mystery of Granny's stolen shoes before dawn.

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -建造堅固的城堡

programme.title: 歡樂弄臣 -大教堂

programme.desc: Addison and Tess make a haunted maze for Halloween, but things take a perplexing turn when it seems that there really is a spooky presence on the loose within it – scaring away all their customers.

programme.title: 偵探艾迪森 -逃跑的機器人之謎
programme.desc: Addison is stumped when she awakens one morning to discover that Eureka and Gyro have disappeared without explanation.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -寶特瓶
programme.desc: Watch Hepi and Briko transform plastic bottles into something out of this world. Literally.

programme.title: 和布里科動手創作 -牙刷
programme.desc: Be prepared to be ''brushed'' off your feet with this entertaining episode.

programme.title: 優可 -完美的寵物

programme.title: 超級英雄飛毛腿 -里歐的新床

programme.desc: The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills season 15 kicks off on Monday,Housewives Erika Jayne, Dorit Kemsley, Kyle Richards, Bozoma Saint John, and Sutton Stracke return for a season marked by fresh starts, major fallouts and unforgettable adventures. New housewife and fashion mogul Rachel Zoe makes a dazzling return to Bravo after more than a decade. Single and stepping back into the spotlight on her own terms, she's ready to unveil RZ 2.0 to the world. Also joining the group is housewife Amanda Frances, a self-made businesswoman who lives in her friend Kyle Richards' former family home. She's determined to build her future in the land of fame and fortune.

programme.sub-title: 第二十九集：魚朝恩與李善德處理荔枝轉運
programme.desc: 來到上林署開會的人對荔枝轉運事宜獻言獻策，李善德着人把有用的策略一一記錄，迅速被分派執行。一朝得勢，竟至如斯，讓李善德滿腹感慨。魚朝恩與李善德並肩開始處理荔枝轉運一事.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂

programme.title: 中華知識王2
programme.sub-title: 第三集 - 張馳豪、詹天文、冼靖峰｜錢錢錢！中國貨幣大百科
programme.desc: 今集三位嘉賓是同一選秀節目出身的同學們：張馳豪(Aska)、詹天文(Windy)和冼靖峰(Archie)。眾人分享在內地工作或旅遊的美好回憶後，就立即進入文學、歷史地理及近代成就，多方面知識大決戰！Archie、Windy和Aska即場活用成語，來一番唇槍舌劍！中國古貨幣除銅錢以外，還有種種意想不到的材質和形態！最終誰能拆解重重難題，「知」取中華知識王令牌？. 主持：曾卓然、糖妹、阮頌陽. 嘉賓：張馳豪、詹天文、冼靖峰. #中華知識王2#曾卓然#糖妹#阮頌陽#張馳豪#詹天文#冼靖峰#山西大同雲岡石窟#中國歷代貨幣.

programme.title: 濾鏡
programme.sub-title: 第八集：羊駝出現在唐奇的家
programme.desc: 蘇橙橙去唐奇家想銷毀蘇渺在拍海報時曾留下的物品，卻被唐奇拒之門外。蘇橙橙無奈變身為蘇渺的寵物羊駝再次敲門，唐奇對萌萌的羊駝很是歡喜。蘇橙橙進屋後大肆破壞，唐奇對羊駝萬般忍耐並傾吐心事，讓她得知了唐奇對蘇渺的情感並非只是因為蘇渺的外表.

programme.title: 傷健同行小僱事
programme.desc: 龍仔（輕度智障），日復日地在倉庫工作，對於大多數人來說，這或許是一份單調而枯燥的工作，但在龍仔的世界裡，一切都有著自己的節奏與秩序。他用專注和堅持，將平凡的每一天過得充實且有條理。而主管Tommy不僅是龍仔上司，更是陪伴他成長的重要夥伴，一直以細心及耐性，在背後給予支持和鼓勵.

programme.title: 大自然深度遊 (普通話版)
programme.desc: 龙脊曾经被国际知名的旅游指南选为「香港最佳远足路线」之一，因为和市区距离接近，加上风景怡人，所以吸引不少游客慕名而来。. 在龙脊更可以360度远眺四周景色，包括大浪湾、清水湾半岛、赤柱等等，其中位于香港岛东南部的石澳也是香港人的周末好去处。. 行完龙脊之后，主持接着去到石澳挑战攀岩活动，也请来研究岩岸生态的专家，教导他们观察依附在岩岸上，那些微小但顽强的生物.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
programme.sub-title: 「同心築夢・百校結好」香江行
programme.desc: 由香港聖公會主辦的「『同心築夢·百校結好』香江行」是系列活動的第一站。為系列餘下的兩個活動奠下兩地持續交流的基石，促進中港學生的友誼建立，深化香港與內地的緊密聯繫。來自甘肅省的中學同學走訪香港的聖公會聖西門呂明才中學，參與觀課及參觀校園，讓甘肅省的同學體會到香港教學的獨特性.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
好鄰居齊學基本法-校園 Special
programme.desc: Harry 哥哥最近化身神探Harry，專門到不同學校為小鄰居排難解紛。第一集就到大埔浸信會公立學校幫助小鄰居俊仔！. 俊仔滿腔熱血，擁有一顆樂於助人的心，發夢都想做班長。誰知他的偉大抱負換來的卻是同學們反對！理由竟然是：「你又不是模範生，憑什麼選班長？」難道真的要科科考第一，才有資格成為候選人？俊仔的「班長夢」難道就此幻滅？. 不過，貓頭鷹博士為大家拆解《基本法》第二十六條，解決大家的疑惑！今集就與Harry 哥哥一同走入大埔浸信會公立學校，踏上一個關乎夢想、規則與公平的旅程！. 《基本法》第二十六條：. 香港特別行政區永久性居民依法享有選舉權和被選舉權. 節目由政制及內地事務局與香港電台聯合製作.

programme.title: 好鄰居齊學基本法-校園 Special
programme.desc: 小四學生寶姸最近因為媽媽的管教而感到煩惱，覺得自己被迫做不想做的事，失去了自由。Harry哥哥決定出手相助，親自到學校了解情況；同時，貓頭鷹博士也透過《基本法》第四條與大家一起思考「自由」的真正意義。究竟寶姸的煩惱背後，藏着甚麼原因？Harry哥哥又能否幫她解開心結？. 《基本法》第四條：. 香港特別行政區依法保障香港特別行政區居民和其他人的權利和自由。. 節目由政制及內地事務局與香港電台聯合製作.

programme.title: 冰雪尖刀連
programme.sub-title: 第十一集：千里追尋離隊的萬里
programme.desc: 認命與七連主力匯合，並引路前往戰場。十五萬志願軍潛伏於蓋馬高原，包圍美軍。大寶偽裝成韓軍逃過偵察隊，卻意外踩到地雷。千里批評萬里的逃兵行為，萬里則表達不願拖累戰友的心聲。在村莊內，志願軍與美軍偵察隊展開激烈交火.

programme.sub-title: 第十八集: 莊圖南對李佳的心意
programme.desc: 莊圖南和李佳在黑房裡沖照片，兩人說起了最近的事情，莊圖南表示遇到李佳的這些時候，就是自己最相信命運的時候。莊圖南想要親李佳…同學要返回上海了，莊圖南問李佳是不是要回黑龍江，李佳表示自己回上海，自己父母這段時間來上海了。二人一起在火車上看到了日出.

programme.title: 小巷人家
programme.sub-title: 第十九集: 李佳對莊圖南態度冷淡
programme.desc: 李佳的上海叔叔嬸嬸不願意讓她的弟弟住在他們的家辦落戶。李佳勸父母回黑龍江，要落戶上海就要像她這樣考上了中學或者大學。莊圖南和李佳回到校園，李佳對他的態度很冷淡，李佳說他們只是同學，幸福對於自己來說是奢侈品.

programme.title: 好鄰居齊學基本法-校園 Special
programme.desc: 今集收到來自小學六年級生思思的訊息，因為她眼見排隊時給領袖生及一位身體不適的同學打尖的，心裡極受委屈，感覺十分不公平，於是向Harry哥哥求助；而其他學生亦對這件事議論紛紛，到底誰對誰錯？就在大家辯論之際，貓頭鷹博士及時出現，並引用了《基本法》第二十五條；但是當公平遇上特殊情況，我們如何做到情、理、法三者兼備呢？. 《基本法》第二十五條. 香港居民在法律面前一律平等。. 節目由政制及內地事務局與香港電台聯合製作.

programme.title: 好鄰居齊學基本法-校園 Special
programme.desc: 嘉陽雖然是一位小學生，但最近獲一位人氣網紅邀請合作拍片打機，更可以賺取酬勞。他滿心歡喜，想把這個「好消息」告訴爸爸，卻遭到爸爸堅決反對。但他認為《基本法》第三十三條保障香港居民有選擇職業的自由，所以覺得爸爸的阻止不合理。就在此時時，貓頭鷹博士進一步講解《基本法》第一百四十七條，指出兒童工作受法律規管和保障，不能隨意從事。在興趣與賺錢之間，嘉陽應該怎樣作出抉擇，才既符合法律，又保障自己成長的需要呢？. 《基本法》第三十三條：. 說明香港居民有選擇職業的自由。. 《基本法》第一百四十七條：. 香港特別行政區自行制定有關勞工的法律和政策。. 節目由政制及內地事務局與香港電台聯合製作.

programme.title: 長安的荔枝
programme.sub-title: 第三十一集：趙辛民覺暗流湧動
programme.desc: 李善德帶着魚常侍重回嶺南，種種端倪讓趙辛民覺暗流湧動，他準備靜觀其變。鄭平安找到阿柴，說破了阿柴與阿土是戀人的往事。兩人想要從阿柴那兒，拿到阿土臨死前所說那份證據.

programme.title: 大自然逐樣解4
programme.desc: 《大自然逐樣解4》邀請了嶺南大學科學教研部助理教授劉彥芹博士及香港生態攝影師馮漢城，分享有關香港瘰螈的生態知識。本集以水、陸瘰螈以及瘰螈胚胎作例子，並利用XR擴增實境技術，以全面生態視野去探索香港瘰螈的外貌特徵、生活習性、以及生存智慧.

programme.title: 民生美食關注組
programme.desc: 旺角豈止是購物聖地那麼簡單？原來「旺角」昔日名為「芒角」，甚至曾有一條「芒角村」。今集《民生美食關注組》將帶領大家穿梭時空，從 1866 年的地圖出發，探尋通菜街、西洋菜街及花園街背後的農村往事。. 除了細訴歷史，當然少不了尋找地道美食。主持會將直擊旺角熟食中心，品嚐餡料豐富的農夫包；隨後轉往油麻地廟街，從傳統粵曲表演中體驗地道的菲律賓美食；最後帶領大家排隊享用每日限量供應的新鮮清湯腩。讓大家一同感受油尖旺區最地道的市井煙火氣息.

programme.title: 濾鏡
programme.sub-title: 第十集：唐奇對方謹有好感
programme.desc: 蘇橙橙沒想到唐奇正好在會議室目睹了一切，關勝宇想讓唐奇為方謹家暴自己作證，但蘇橙橙隨後則以方謹身分約唐奇見面，請求他能為方謹保守秘密，沒想到遭到唐奇的拒絕。然而，經過兩人在咖啡館裏的交談，唐奇看着和服務員親切互動的方謹，被她可愛親和的樣子打動.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 我家是個博物館
programme.desc: 73歲的新疆爺爺喜愛老物件，收藏老物件，希望一屋子的老物件可以傳承下去，讓以後的娃娃們能夠了解先人們用過的物件。另一邊廂，吳爾平才20歲出頭，但收藏化學元素已近十年。化學物質的美麗和奇妙吸引他集齊了1到80號的化學元素.

programme.title: 冰雪尖刀連
programme.sub-title: 第十二集：五連長六六順壯烈犧牲
programme.desc: 五連彈藥告罄，萬里找到美軍的彈藥來補給。千里和六六順奮勇炸坦克，萬里不顧危險也摧毀一輛。梅生率七連趕到，逆轉戰局。六六順臨終囑託千里帶五連回家。聯合國軍忽視中國軍隊實力，北極熊團遭伏擊，防線一退再退.

小巷人家
programme.sub-title: 第二十集: 林武峰被人告密
programme.desc: 林武峰被人告密，說了他在外面兼職的事情，廠長要林武峰要暫停技術上的工作。林棟哲知道父親出事了，變得現在非常用功讀書。林武峰跟宋瑩說在廣交會時認識的一個廣東企業，希望林武峰能到他們那裡去工作，還可以解決落戶。林武峰想去，宋瑩覺得為甚麼要跑到這麼遠.

programme.title: 小巷人家
programme.sub-title: 第二十一集: 林武峰一家到廣州
programme.desc: 宋瑩和林武峰跟林棟哲說想要去廣州發展，要把林棟哲也帶到那邊去讀書，林棟哲一口答應下來。林武峰晚上偷偷走了，表示自己這一次走不是很光彩的事情，別人不管說什麼，宋瑩都要忍住。之後，宋瑩去廣州會合林武峰，她拜託黃玲在這個暑假照顧林棟哲.

programme.title: 快樂魔法森林
programme.desc: 五位勇敢的英雄接受了一個任務，要運送三十個氣球給菲斯的表弟，但事情並不是想像中那麼容易.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 今集《小農夫大作物新一彈》帶觀眾到訪札幌市手稻區的一間豆腐店。究竟多優質和精緻的豆腐，才能獲得日本第一的美譽？主持們亦會介紹各款健康的豆腐菜式，例如以豆渣代替肉碎的麻婆豆腐.

programme.title: 長安的荔枝
programme.sub-title: 第三十二集：蘇諒徹底失望
programme.desc: 何有光不願坐以待斃，讓趙辛民發放荔枝股，先一步把這些利益給右相送過去。右相眼裏，誰能幫他斂財，誰才有價值。趙辛民來到廣場，憑藉三寸不爛之舌遊說眾人，打算發放荔枝股。蘇諒看到荔枝股，徹底失望.

怒放
programme.desc: 本集將視角從競技賽場延伸至幕後，聚焦默默為運動員逐夢築牢支撐的團體——無私奉獻的志願者、深耕科技助殘的工作者、推進場館無障礙改造的團隊、用心做好輔具服務保障的工作者。他們以責任為帆，以熱愛為槳，用默默堅守與全力付出，成為運動員最堅強的後盾，凸顯責任與熱愛交織的溫暖力量。. 播映時間：2月10日星期二晚上8點.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
綠惜見未來
programme.desc: In recent years, green buildings have become a growing trend in the construction industry. Many people believe that installing solar panels or implementing greening projects automatically makes a building environmentally friendly. But is this really the case?. Buildings account for nearly 90% of Hong Kong's total electricity consumption, with residential homes, offices, and shopping malls contributing to nearly 60% of the city’s carbon emissions. Achieving energy savings and emission reductions through buildings is no easy task. On top of that, Hong Kong has over 40,000 existing older buildings. How can these aging structures be retrofitted to improve energy efficiency? What methods can be employed.

programme.title: 夢中的那片海
programme.sub-title: 第三十二集：肖春生為醫院購入復健器材
programme.desc: 肖春生來到康復中心看望昔日的病友，看到他們康復器材非常緊缺。肖春生來到佟曉梅的家裏，曉梅的父親知道了肖春生的玉器生意掙了不少錢，希望春生把錢用在正道上。肖春生告訴曉梅，自己想要為康復醫院做點事，他想要給醫院弄一些復健的器材。肖春生找陳宏軍幫忙介紹.

programme.title: 夢中的那片海
programme.sub-title: 第三十三集：醫院要求肖春生公司賠款
programme.desc: 肖春生創立春曉醫療，肖春生見曉梅的媽媽，他讓醫院免費試用他們的產品，醫院覺得效果好品質好再訂購。京西醫院下產品訂單，春曉醫療終於可以發工資。春曉醫療賣的貨品出現問題，醫院要求賠款，肖春生承诺還清賠款，並決定了不能依賴進口產品，他們要做自己的產品.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
運動明星又過界
programme.desc: 港隊空手道（型）代表近年在國際賽屢創佳績，不但於2020年東京奧運歷史性獲得女子組銅牌，更登上世界排名第一，開始備受注目。. 唱作歌手鄭俊弘Fred雖然有著廣為人知的好歌喉，但他的武術運動員身份卻鮮為人知。從小練習南拳與蔡李佛拳的他首次學習以速度、力量及平衡力缺一不可的空手道（型），如何為他打開一個嶄新的武術世界.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈： 琉森音樂節2017
守藝薪傳
programme.desc: 在珠江三角洲的傳統藝術中，手托木偶戲自光緒年間便紮根於香港，曾是廟會、醮會和盂蘭節的重要表演項目。「香港華山傳統木偶粵劇團」是香港最後一個手托木偶班，團主陳錦濤師傅一直守護著最後一批香港獨有的廣東手托木偶，而今年二十四歲的黃式瑜是陳師傅最年輕的徒弟，因緣際會愛上這門藝術。在厦村太平清醮這難得的十年一遇盛會中，她首次正式參與演出，見證了這門藝術的莊嚴與傳承.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
《科學 ∙ 創未來3》
programme.desc: How did scientists embark on their journeys? What challenges and doubts have they come across along the way? These experiences are undoubtedly invaluable to future scientists aspiring to undertake scientific research. . The four laureates this year, Professor Xing XU, Professor Zhonghe ZHOU, Professor Xi DAI and Professor Hong DING, specially attended the talk “Dialogue with the Youth” for young people. They had close exchanges with Hong Kong secondary students from different schools, during which they delved into topics from palaeontology to forefront condensed matter physics, and shared their journeys of growth. The talk brought the Prize Week to a perfect close.

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: 何濼嬅天生患有耳骨硬化症，耳朵一邊聽不到聲音，另一邊借助助聽器也僅有5%的聽力。自幼與人溝通多是看口型，但藉著後天的努力練習，就算聽力有限，她說話十分清晰。長大後，她去學習西廚，特別喜歡整蛋糕，在過程中她得到了滿足感。. Hugo是社企創辦人，他留意到聽障婦女在工作時展現出細膩與專注，決定在一間超市內成立一間烘焙店，其中一位烘焙師就是何濼嬅，她每天早晨負責麵包的出爐、整形與包裝。在這無聲的環境中，烘焙師傅和街坊的互動如何？今集主持Marco吳祉昊會去探訪這些安靜細心的烘焙師.

programme.title: 廣東話去旅行 ： 北京篇
政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
十二封信
programme.desc: 2026年，余念前往已更名為浦水的梅灣鎮調查，遇到從英國回來尋找失蹤母親的沈程，兩人互相猜疑。1991年，葉海棠因刺父事件被孤立，唐亦尋卻默默幫她還債、墊付班費，展現溫柔一面。兩人開始探究神秘郵筒的真相，葉海棠發現自己投入的「遺書」也不見了。同時，唐亦尋三兄弟因毆打追債人，面臨黑道報復.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
周末大電影：新上海灘
programme.desc: 年青軍官許文強(張國榮飾)被日軍追殺墮海,飄浮到外灘岸上,幸得丁力(劉德華飾)相救,不打不相識下結為好友.上海大亨馮敬堯(吳興國飾)利用二人剷除其他阻礙他的勢力,二人不虞有詐.強終發現當日在船上遭伏擊的幕後黑手乃馮敬堯,強抓起開信刀狂剌堯,程程(寧靜飾)不堪打擊成一瘋婦,力痛心不已,決先一步找出強算賬.

programme.title: 傷健同行小僱事
programme.desc: 龍仔（輕度智障），日復日地在倉庫工作，對於大多數人來說，這或許是一份單調而枯燥的工作，但在龍仔的世界裡，一切都有著自己的節奏與秩序。他用專注和堅持，將平凡的每一天過得充實且有條理。而主管Tommy不僅是龍仔上司，更是陪伴他成長的重要夥伴，一直以細心及耐性，在背後給予支持和鼓勵.

programme.title: 醫生與你
programme.desc: 「病從口入」相信大家都聽過這句說話，但食物中毒卻常在我們日常生活中被忽略。根據衛生防護中心的數字，2025年就有129宗食物中毒個案，受影響人數達到682人；而今年截至3月10日，受影響人數已超過200人，當中細菌及病毒感染是導致食物中毒的主要原因。. 今集節目將會為大家探討一些經常導致食物中毒的病原體，以及它們常在哪些食物出沒，好讓大家減低食物中毒的風險。. 主持：黃婉曼、董光達醫生. 嘉賓：薛詠珊醫生(中大醫學院賽馬會公共衛生及基層醫療學院副教授(臨床)).

programme.title: 中華知識王2
programme.sub-title: 第四集 - 黃捷穎、馮皓揚、陳紫萱｜世代流傳建築技術智慧！
programme.desc: 第四集的星級嘉賓是黃捷穎Vinky 、演員馮皓揚和陳紫萱Summer。動靜皆宜的前國家跨欄運動員Vinky，帶來了自己繪畫的龍插畫作品與大家分享。環保、歷史地理、中國近代建設、文學、傳統文化及等等的題目包羅萬有，嘉賓們又能否一一解答？若然畫功好又能否佔盡優勢？一件歷史源遠流長的木製小玩意，居然蘊含中國古代建築技術的大智慧，以三位嘉賓的學識智慧又能否破解，最後成功取得中華知識王的美譽呢？. 主持：曾卓然、糖妹、阮頌陽. 嘉賓：黃捷穎、馮皓揚、陳紫萱. #中華知識王2 #曾卓然#糖妹#阮頌陽#黃捷穎#馮皓揚#陳紫萱#東北長白山#中國建築技術.

programme.title: 廣東話去旅行 ： 北京篇
運動明星又過界
programme.desc: 港隊空手道（型）代表近年在國際賽屢創佳績，不但於2020年東京奧運歷史性獲得女子組銅牌，更登上世界排名第一，開始備受注目。. 唱作歌手鄭俊弘Fred雖然有著廣為人知的好歌喉，但他的武術運動員身份卻鮮為人知。從小練習南拳與蔡李佛拳的他首次學習以速度、力量及平衡力缺一不可的空手道（型），如何為他打開一個嶄新的武術世界.

programme.title: 十二封信
programme.desc: 2026年，余念前往已更名為浦水的梅灣鎮調查，遇到從英國回來尋找失蹤母親的沈程，兩人互相猜疑。1991年，葉海棠因刺父事件被孤立，唐亦尋卻默默幫她還債、墊付班費，展現溫柔一面。兩人開始探究神秘郵筒的真相，葉海棠發現自己投入的「遺書」也不見了。同時，唐亦尋三兄弟因毆打追債人，面臨黑道報復.

programme.title: 綠惜見未來
programme.desc: In recent years, green buildings have become a growing trend in the construction industry. Many people believe that installing solar panels or implementing greening projects automatically makes a building environmentally friendly. But is this really the case?. Buildings account for nearly 90% of Hong Kong's total electricity consumption, with residential homes, offices, and shopping malls contributing to nearly 60% of the city’s carbon emissions. Achieving energy savings and emission reductions through buildings is no easy task. On top of that, Hong Kong has over 40,000 existing older buildings. How can these aging structures be retrofitted to improve energy efficiency? What methods can be employed.

programme.title: 香港故事-世界美食堂
programme.desc: 本集帶觀眾走進西班牙飲食文化的慢活世界。從早上的西班牙薯仔蛋餅及西班牙油炸鬼開始，探索一日五餐的從容生活哲學。之後我們會近距離欣賞西班牙火腿侍肉師的精湛刀工，了解火腿分級、藝術擺盤及品嚐秘訣；再向大廚們發掘西班牙小菜的歷史，以及飯後圍桌閒聊的社交禮儀。主持透過食物連結香港急速節奏與西班牙漫遊旅程，發掘熱情、誠實、分享背後的文化故事.

programme.title: 再登地球之巔
programme.desc: 板塊大碰撞撞出了青藏高原，同時也造就出了青藏高原上空的巨型「抽風機」。這個「抽風機」徹底顛覆了控制中國北緯30度上空的星際風系，印度洋和太平洋的水汽也被強力抽吸上高原，由此影響了中國、亞洲，甚至全球的氣候。在第二次青藏科考中，科學家探入從未到達的深空、掃描橫跨數千公里的超級渦流、追蹤異常降水帶、遠赴南海監測水汽路徑，期待揭開青藏高原上的空中祕境.

programme.title: 醫生與你
programme.desc: 「病從口入」相信大家都聽過這句說話，但食物中毒卻常在我們日常生活中被忽略。根據衛生防護中心的數字，2025年就有129宗食物中毒個案，受影響人數達到682人；而今年截至3月10日，受影響人數已超過200人，當中細菌及病毒感染是導致食物中毒的主要原因。. 今集節目將會為大家探討一些經常導致食物中毒的病原體，以及它們常在哪些食物出沒，好讓大家減低食物中毒的風險。. 主持：黃婉曼、董光達醫生. 嘉賓：薛詠珊醫生(中大醫學院賽馬會公共衛生及基層醫療學院副教授(臨床)).

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 余市町是日本其中一個盛產生果的地方。他們現時出產18個品種。今次請來了兩位北海道模特兒來一起參與。收割過後，大家一起比較不同品種的特點。每一種都各具特色，味道、口感原全不一樣.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 兄妹倆都想獨佔房間，灶君利用神環相助，表面是幫他們解決煩惱，實際是想讓倆人反思並為對方着想；另一邊，灶君對落戶趙家心有不甘，準備偷偷換一家，卻因已掛名落戶，無法脫離趙家.

programme.title: 家有灶君
programme.desc: 灶君原計劃向天庭申請調離趙家，天庭同意並派車接他。然而，住了幾日後，灶君逐漸對趙家產生感情，決定幫忙完成訂單上的元宵。沒想到，他坐錯車，不僅沒回天庭，還錯把湯圓送到天庭.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 杜老師在課堂上抽查菲菲背古詩，菲菲又出洋相。小鬱安慰她卻被菲菲遷怒，傷心地跑開。菲菲後悔想道歉，但小鬱失踪。如福幫忙找到了小鬱，菲菲誠心道歉，兩人和好.

programme.title: 如福侍衛隊
programme.desc: 院子裡的地瓜乾消失了，為了找出偷吃賊，如福們守株待兔，發現地窖後隱藏的大空間，找到偷吃的地鼠阿疤和阿豁。夏美利用與動物溝通的能力，得知牠們在儲存冬糧.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 蜜蜂大師
programme.desc: 在埃塞俄比亞，蜜蜂不僅僅是繁衍與豐饒的象徵，更承載著這個全球第二古老的基督教國家的信仰.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 蜜蜂大師
programme.desc: 在墨西哥，蜜蜂奉獻如此之多，以至於該國成為全球蜂蜜生產的領導者。蜜蜂激發了人們的尊敬與欽佩.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: Hong Kong is riding a “pet‑friendly” wave. Malls, restaurants, and even public transport are opening to pets, reshaping city life and sparking new economic opportunities. The programme explores pet‑only mall floors, pet‑friendly transit, and expert views on how this trend could transform Hong Kong’s consumer landscape.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
programme.sub-title: 「心繫家國・絲路華彩 · 同心築夢」香港聖公會青少年西部國情研學活動分享會
programme.desc: 活動分享會由香港聖公會主辦，是該會舉行之系列活動第二站。參與學生從甘肅省交流回港，透過手機攝影比賽、行程匯報等項目分享他們在甘肅省研學的所見所聞.

programme.title: 香港故事：情繫香港
programme.sub-title: Turkey's Cultural Fusion in Hong Kong
programme.desc: Whether it's the traditional Turkish mosaic lamps or Turkish coffee, they both carry a rich history and culture, serving as a bridge for mutual understanding between Turkish and Hong Kong people. Two Turkish brothers, recognizing the business potential in Hong Kong, opened the first Turkish restaurant and introduced halal food practices.

programme.title: 夢中的那片海
programme.sub-title: 第三十四集：冰場上的兄弟重聚
programme.desc: 葉芳知道了陳宏軍和他的哥哥葉國華一起做生意，葉芳告訴陳宏軍不要害哥哥，兩個人為此大吵一架。來到二十一世紀，佟曉梅依然在醫院忙碌著，賀紅玲離開了舞臺，而葉芳和陳宏軍的關係幾近冰點，肖春生的事業蒸蒸日上，還把當年冰場上的兄弟都聚在春曉.

programme.title: 夢中的那片海
programme.sub-title: 第三十五集：葉國華觀摩肖春生的公司
programme.desc: 肖春生決定和葉國華的華盛集團合作，他帶葉國華來到他的公司觀摩。葉國華發現了肖春生的公司裏有好多他認識的兄弟。失聯的這些年，葉國華對於肖春生的一切一無所知，葉國華轉業後一直在心裏和肖春生較勁兒，不過肖春生從未把葉國華視為對手。葉國華回到家後越想越生氣.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
programme.sub-title: 「心繫家國・絲路華彩 · 同心築夢」香港聖公會青少年西部國情研學活動分享會
programme.desc: 活動分享會由香港聖公會主辦，是該會舉行之系列活動第二站。參與學生從甘肅省交流回港，透過手機攝影比賽、行程匯報等項目分享他們在甘肅省研學的所見所聞.

programme.title: 學人沙龍
programme.desc: 十九世紀末，列強覬覦東北資源，俄國與日本先後在滿洲鋪設鐵路，以鋼軌劃分勢力範圍。從中東鐵路到南滿鐵道，車轍所至不僅運載旅客貨物，更承載帝國擴張的野心。鐵道沿線至今留存大量異國風格的車站與建築群。本集與觀眾走訪遼東大地，追溯滿洲鐵路的興建始末，透過沿途建築遺產，細說列強角力下東北近代的獨特歷程。. 主持. 曾卓然(嶺南大學中文系哲學博士). 譚家齊(香港浸會大學歷史系副教授). 徐頌雯(嶺南大學歷史系副教授). 吳海傑(香港大學法律學院教授及副院長(研究)).

programme.title: 運動明星又過界
programme.desc: 運動攀登近年從極限運動轉變成戶內及老少鹹宜的運動，並雲集各路攀登高手於奧運場上競技。備受港人關注的長洲搶包山亦是運動攀登中速度賽與難度賽的結合。. 香港足球運動員歐陽耀冲（歐冲）一向在綠茵場上奔跑，這次跟著六屆包山后學習跌、抱石、扭腰移動、跳躍等動作，甚至跟教練比拼速度賽！他能否憑藉運動員不服輸的拼勁贏得首次速度賽.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈．開放舞台：奧菲歐與尤麗迪采
programme.sub-title: 奧菲歐與尤麗迪采 (上集)
programme.desc: 本劇講述奧菲歐痛失愛妻尤麗迪采後，毅然闖入冥界，誓言帶回妻子。愛神賜予他救贖的機會，卻設下「不可回頭」的嚴苛條件。奧菲歐歷經怨靈阻攔、冥界幻景，終與尤麗迪采重逢，卻在返回人間的最後關頭，因妻子的悲傷質疑而絕望回首，導致永別。最終愛神為其深情所動，讓愛人重生，見證真愛超越生死。歌劇片段由香港非凡美樂提供。. 藝術總監：盧景文. 監製及導演：梁笑君. 指揮：杜洛沙. 演出：. 李卓麟. 金雅修. 沈喜詠. 鄧思寧、文浚彥. Rebaroque Orchestra. 非凡美樂合唱團.

programme.title: 演藝盛薈．開放舞台：泛亞交響樂團 凌顯祐．新世界
programme.sub-title: 泛亞交響樂團 凌顯祐．新世界
programme.desc: 泛亞交響樂團成立接近五十年，創辦人葉惠康博士一直擔任樂團音樂總監及指揮，以推廣音樂給市民大眾為理念，演出逾幾百場音樂會。《演藝盛薈．開放舞台：泛亞交響樂團凌顯祐．新世界》其實是年逾九十的葉博士交棒予新任樂團音樂總監凌顯祐的莊嚴儀式。葉、凌二人在台上分享了他們的深厚情感，觀眾無不動容。. 音樂會上半場，凌顯祐邀請了兩位他在香港管弦樂團的同袍–單簧管首席史安祖、及低音單簧管手艾爾高演出，兩位樂手在樂曲的表現上發揮高超的技巧而充滿玩味感。音樂會的標題「凌顯祐‧新世界」與下半場樂團演出的德伏扎克E小調第九交響曲，又名「新世界交響曲」，兩者互相呼應，觀眾可見證新總監凌顯祐如何傳承葉博士的音樂理念，帶領樂團提升到另一新境界。音樂會片段由泛亞交響樂團攝製及提供。. 曲目：. 1.龐吉耶利：單簧管二重奏及樂隊的作品. 2.孟德爾遜：為單簧管，巴塞管及樂隊而寫的音樂會作品第一首. 3.德伏扎克：E小調第九交響曲，「新世界.

programme.title: 生活．健康．資訊．體育．港式速遞
好鄰居齊學基本法-校園 Special
programme.desc: 有一位小鄰居發現家中突然出現一個神秘的綠色信封，之後更察覺爸爸的態度開始有些不同。原本爸爸答應，只要他考試成績理想，就帶他去主題樂園玩和吃大餐，沒想到現在竟然食言！Harry 哥哥覺得事情並不簡單，於是決定到學校一探究竟。與此同時，貓頭鷹博士登場，為大家解開疑團，指出這件事與《基本法》有關。面對個人利益與整體社會責任之間，我們又應該如何取捨呢？. 《基本法》第四十二條：. 香港居民和在香港的其他人有遵守香港特別行政區實行的法律的義務。. 《基本法》第一百零八條：. 香港特別行政區實行獨立的稅收制度。香港特別行政區參照原在香港實行的低稅政策，自行立法規定稅種、稅率、稅收寬免和其他稅務事項。. 節目由政制及內地事務局與香港電台聯合製作.

programme.title: 《遇見美麗中國第二季》
programme.desc: 縱貫南北的千里長河，書寫人水共生的中國方案，向北方輸送源源不絕的清泉，背後是百萬「守水人」的誓言；當西溪濕地重現珍稀飛鳥，桃花水母成為水質「晴雨表」，這些工作使我們深切了解，清水源流是文明延續的生命基因.

programme.title: IP 新機遇 (普通話版)
programme.desc: 在創意驅動的市場裡，知識產權是品牌成長背後的重要後盾。香港有一個本地曲奇品牌，由用心的創作者以品質與誠意打動顧客，逐步建立屬於自己的口碑。. 今集將帶大家了解，品牌如何運用商標保障自身形象，守護品牌價值，在激烈競爭中脫穎而出，并且透過持續創新，讓一塊曲奇成為能被記住的故事，延伸出更大的品牌力量.

programme.title: 西藏·星空下的傳奇
programme.desc: 《星途》循著藏曆節律，講述高原上人與自然的相守與探索。科研者達娃三十年追蹤西藏蝴蝶，在墨脫雨林、吉隆溝等險境中記錄近600種蝶類，用科學解碼生命密碼，更以藏文命名編撰圖鑑.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 2025/26學年「心繫家國」聯校國民教育活動巡禮
十二封信
programme.sub-title: 第四集：我想給你一個晴天，但我只有一把烏雲做的傘
programme.desc: 1991年，唐亦尋三兄弟的檯球屋被黑道砸毀，買船錢也被搶走。葉海棠在家遭受父親暴打，為唐亦尋包紮傷口時，兩個傷痕累累的靈魂終於靠近。他們夜守郵筒，發現葉海棠投進去的「遺書」竟憑空返回。2026年，沈程與余念為郵筒的真偽爭執不休，張泉卻在午夜將「遺書」扔進了郵筒，觸發了奇蹟.

周末大電影 : 冰風暴
programme.desc: In the 1970's decade, a suburban Connecticut couple grapples with infidelity and personal dissatisfaction while their teenage children seek sexual freedom. The eventful Thanksgiving weekend makes them take a hard look at their lives.

programme.title: 港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 唱作歌手李靖筠(Gladys)近年嘗試R&B慵懶風格，同樣身為唱作人的布志綸(Alan)，作品就揉合搖滾、抒情，風格多變。兩位將同時上《港樂．講樂》的舞台現場演唱最新派台歌，更會一齊大玩遊戲！. 主持. 阮頌陽. 歌曲：. 李靖筠《最好比我更懶》. 布志綸《貼哋.

programme.title: 西藏·星空下的傳奇
programme.desc: 《星途》循著藏曆節律，講述高原上人與自然的相守與探索。科研者達娃三十年追蹤西藏蝴蝶，在墨脫雨林、吉隆溝等險境中記錄近600種蝶類，用科學解碼生命密碼，更以藏文命名編撰圖鑑.

programme.title: 運動明星又過界
programme.desc: 運動攀登近年從極限運動轉變成戶內及老少鹹宜的運動，並雲集各路攀登高手於奧運場上競技。備受港人關注的長洲搶包山亦是運動攀登中速度賽與難度賽的結合。. 香港足球運動員歐陽耀冲（歐冲）一向在綠茵場上奔跑，這次跟著六屆包山后學習跌、抱石、扭腰移動、跳躍等動作，甚至跟教練比拼速度賽！他能否憑藉運動員不服輸的拼勁贏得首次速度賽.

programme.title: 十二封信
programme.sub-title: 第四集：我想給你一個晴天，但我只有一把烏雲做的傘

programme.title: 《遇見美麗中國第二季》
programme.desc: 縱貫南北的千里長河，書寫人水共生的中國方案，向北方輸送源源不絕的清泉，背後是百萬「守水人」的誓言；當西溪濕地重現珍稀飛鳥，桃花水母成為水質「晴雨表」，這些工作使我們深切了解，清水源流是文明延續的生命基因.

programme.title: IP 新機遇 (普通話版)
programme.desc: 在創意驅動的市場裡，知識產權是品牌成長背後的重要後盾。香港有一個本地曲奇品牌，由用心的創作者以品質與誠意打動顧客，逐步建立屬於自己的口碑。. 今集將帶大家了解，品牌如何運用商標保障自身形象，守護品牌價值，在激烈競爭中脫穎而出，并且透過持續創新，讓一塊曲奇成為能被記住的故事，延伸出更大的品牌力量.

programme.title: 鏗鏘集
programme.desc: Hong Kong is riding a “pet‑friendly” wave. Malls, restaurants, and even public transport are opening to pets, reshaping city life and sparking new economic opportunities. The programme explores pet‑only mall floors, pet‑friendly transit, and expert views on how this trend could transform Hong Kong’s consumer landscape.

programme.title: 香港故事：情繫香港
programme.sub-title: Turkey's Cultural Fusion in Hong Kong
programme.desc: Whether it's the traditional Turkish mosaic lamps or Turkish coffee, they both carry a rich history and culture, serving as a bridge for mutual understanding between Turkish and Hong Kong people. Two Turkish brothers, recognizing the business potential in Hong Kong, opened the first Turkish restaurant and introduced halal food practices.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 蜜蜂大師
programme.desc: 在埃塞俄比亞，蜜蜂不僅僅是繁衍與豐饒的象徵，更承載著這個全球第二古老的基督教國家的信仰.

programme.title: 31看世界 - 蜜蜂大師
programme.desc: 在墨西哥，蜜蜂奉獻如此之多，以至於該國成為全球蜂蜜生產的領導者。蜜蜂激發了人們的尊敬與欽佩.

programme.title: 怒放
programme.desc: 本集將視角從競技賽場延伸至幕後，聚焦默默為運動員逐夢築牢支撐的團體——無私奉獻的志願者、深耕科技助殘的工作者、推進場館無障礙改造的團隊、用心做好輔具服務保障的工作者。他們以責任為帆，以熱愛為槳，用默默堅守與全力付出，成為運動員最堅強的後盾，凸顯責任與熱愛交織的溫暖力量。. 播映時間：2月10日星期二晚上8點.

programme.title: 冰雪尖刀連
programme.sub-title: 第十三集：七連對敵發動猛烈攻勢
programme.desc: 雷公帶炮排沖鋒，萬里展示投彈天賦，用手榴彈炸毀美軍坦克。梅生駕車率七連突破雷區，發起猛烈攻勢，北極熊團潰散。七連炮排遭到美軍的炮火轟擊，迫擊炮支架被炸斷，身受重傷的長喜以身體作為支撐，大壯含淚作戰。漢斯請求反擊未果，上校逃避戰局.

小巷人家
programme.sub-title: 第二十二集: 莊超英對孩子發火
programme.desc: 莊超英叫孩子到祖父母家一趟，兩個人都不太願意，找各種藉口推來推去。莊超英非常生氣，一怒之下揮手打了筱婷一巴掌。鵬飛說祖父母曾恐嚇筱婷，說過如果他們學習成績不好，父母就要離婚。林武峰來信了，讓莊圖南和林棟哲一起去廣州，初到廣州，莊圖南目不暇接.

programme.title: 小巷人家
programme.sub-title: 第二十三集: 莊圖南畢業後的選擇
programme.desc: 在廣州的林棟哲想起了從小和莊筱婷長大的點點滴滴，十分想念她。林棟哲打電話給筱婷，說決定跟她報同一所大學，莊筱婷聽了也很高興。莊圖南畢業後會分配回蘇州工作，但他想讀研究班。莊超英覺得讀了研也不一定能留在上海，他和黃玲希望莊圖南能找一份安穩的工作.

programme.title: 快樂魔法森林
programme.desc: 五位勇敢的英雄正在執行任務，但阿菇掉進了一個神秘的洞穴裡，而洞穴裡的小蘑菇們竟然把他當作國王….

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 今集主持人會學習以北海道食材，製作豆沙餡料。豆沙餡的款式包羅萬有，有粒粒豆沙、綿滑豆沙，亦有分紅豆製和白腰豆製的！另外，他們還嘗試製作豆沙包，不知味道如何呢.

programme.title: 長安的荔枝
programme.sub-title: 第三十三集：何有光赴約鴻門宴
programme.desc: 何有光命令將高州封城，魚常侍毫無懼色，約何有光赴約鴻門宴。魚朝恩揭開了何有光的野心，以及背後真正的主人。當年何有光取代海虎到長安，投靠貴人，蟄伏在高州隨時待命.

programme.title: 睇得見。聽得到
programme.desc: 藝術無界限，一眾展能藝術家除了表演自己專長的藝術項目，亦在彼此藝術範疇以外作出新嘗試，今次是「做戲」！展能藝術家趙惠芝和李昇，會和主持Angel梁安琪、富爸爸岑幸富分享他們今次的藝術經歷。展能藝術家伍惠娟會和沙畫藝術家胡藹的一同傾下彼此藝術交流的樂趣和故事.

programme.title: 香港故事-世界美食堂
programme.desc: 鮮豔的顏色層次、衝擊的味覺體驗，泰菜的魅力席捲亞洲。主廚Art Sinlaparkorn在本集會分享泰國料理中酸、辣、鹹、甜的精妙平衡，以及自己的烹飪哲學。兒時受祖母啟發，令他醉心於泰國料理的藝術，踏上成為廚師之路。Chef Art將從小到大嘗遍的泰國地道風味，直接複製到香港；更邀請主持Andy Dark細嚐青木瓜沙律、醉貓炒河、泰式椰子煎餅等街頭美食。. 離開家鄉追隨夢想，Chef Art幸運地在香港遇上他的「另一半」。他們與一班同鄉好友，慢慢在香港建立另一個「家」.

programme.title: 31 看世界 - 物種大滅絕
programme.desc: 印度住了約27,000隻亞洲象，擁有全世界最大型的亞洲象群落。雖然印度能每日為每隻亞洲象提供450公斤食物，但牠們的存活卻面臨威脅。亞洲象對高溫敏感，炎熱天氣可引發牠們出現代謝症候群、氧化壓力、免疫抑制反應，甚至死亡，而影響繁殖率。目前印度境內有約42%的亞洲象棲息地，因為人為壓力和氣候變化夾擊而消失。. 印度環境、森林及氣候變化部門和一眾動物專家，正努力創建環保通道，協助大象暢通無阻地搬家。我們一於隨著專家和本地居民，去看看這些亞洲象能否在氣候變化威脅之下倖存下來。. India is home to approximately 27,000 Asian Elephants, which is the world’s largest population of the species. The country may be the species’ main stronghold, helping each elephant consume 450 kg of food every day. But its survival is now under threat. . Their sensitivity to heat leads to metabolic disorders, oxidative stress, immune suppression, and death, impacting their reproduction rates. Some 42% of the present available habitat in the country will be lost due to the combined effects of human pressure and climate change. . The elephants are likely to shift towards higher elevations in the Himalayas. We follow animals’ activists along with the Ministry of Environment, Forests and Climate Change in India who are battling to create a green corridor to help them to travel and shift habitats without issue and give legal protection to the movement of elephants. . Can the Asian elephant survive these modern threats to its existence.

小巷人家
programme.sub-title: 第二十四集: 林棟哲與莊筱婷再做同學
programme.desc: 莊圖南與李佳畢業聚會就要分開了。林棟哲真的考上了莊筱婷同一所上海的大學，他返回蘇州親自告訴莊筱婷這個好消息。黃玲表示宋瑩要是在的話，一定要敲鑼打鼓昭告天下。向鵬飛高考成績不理想，他母親希望他重讀考大學，求哥哥莊超英繼續收留鵬飛，不過鵬飛已另有打算.

programme.title: 小巷人家
programme.sub-title: 第二十五集: 林棟哲嫌莊圖南破壞約會
programme.desc: 林棟哲約了莊筱婷看電影，等了很久都沒有等到她，原來莊圖南來了探妹妹，林棟哲想要讓莊圖南趕緊走。鄰居張阿妹想要住在宋瑩空著的房子，對人說宋瑩把房子租給她，但黃玲覺得宋瑩不可能不告訴自己把房子租出。新政策下林武峰可以回去蘇州的單位了，但林武峰並不願意.

programme.title: 快樂魔法森林
programme.desc: 赫伯特發明了一頂不實用的「降溫帽子」，卡通動畫有趣兒童輕鬆並遭受謎語大師的嘲笑，然而最後他卻用這頂帽子拯救了世界.

programme.title: 小農夫大作物 新一彈
programme.desc: 瀧川市擁有領先日本的油菜種植園區。農民會在露天的田播種，在溫室收割。命名「雪割油菜」的農夫，2009年時曾出演本節目。油菜農民太太煮的菜式相當美味.

programme.title: 長安的荔枝
programme.sub-title: 第三十四集：雲清拉攏趙辛民
programme.desc: 雲清要將趙辛民拉到自己的陣營，她給趙辛民講了一個故事. . . .沒有了雙層甕，荔枝轉運眼看就要失敗，在最後關頭，李善德想到，可以用竹筒存放荔枝.

programme.title: 政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
政正關你事 - 官員講話摘要
港樂 • 講樂
programme.desc: 布志綸(Alan)，前樂隊主唱兼唱作人，作品融入生活體悟，觸動人心。李靖筠(Gladys)，由模特兒轉型做演員，再成為歌手，一直嘗試不同的曲風。兩位唱作歌手一起來到《港樂．講樂》，近距離向樂迷獻唱動人情歌。. 主持. 阮頌陽. 歌曲：. 李靖筠《2+1=1》. 布志綸《如是因如是果.

programme.title: 31看世界 – 維克托的極限清單2
programme.sub-title: 與安達盧西亞牛仔同行
programme.desc: 維克托將會躍上馬背，展開這趟挑戰旅程。他先跟隨馴馬師學習，再前往法蘭琪-康堤寄宿於一個「牛仔之家」，藉此裝備自己，為參與西班牙安達盧西亞歷史悠久的「雌馬出巡」習俗做好準備。. 屆時，維克托會與一眾安達盧西亞傳奇野馬牧人並肩，護送上千匹野生雌馬，從多尼亞納國家公園出發，跨越威爾瓦的廣袤田野，前往阿爾蒙特。這次旅程彷彿穿越時空，帶領觀眾走入一個以馬為尊的世界.

programme.title: 香港故事:尾巴會說話(英文版)
醫生與你 - 講飲講食講健康
programme.sub-title: #6 A Versatile and All-purpose Food Ingredient – Eggs
programme.desc: This healthy food ingredient can be found in the fridge of almost every household. Kids love them, adults love them, and they show up as the star or just a sidekick in tons of dishes. Although eggs seem to be healthy and wholesome, it was once said that egg yolks would trigger the cholesterol problem. How would the latest research explain the issue? According to Chinese medicine theory, one should not consume eggs when having a wound, because eggs are “stimulating food”. How should we consume eggs for the best of our health?. In this episode, the “Food Fanatics” will bring us to a local chicken farm to see how to make hens lay quality eggs, and get tips on how to choose good eggs. In the kitchen, the chef host Will will prepare a creative “Chinese steamed egg trio” with Maggie LEUNG, and Dr TSUI Chak-cheong, Chinese medicine practitioner and a body builder, is invited to share the dos and don’ts for egg consumption. . Hosts: Maggie LEUNG, Will LEUNG (Chef). Guest: Dr TSUI Chak-cheong (Registered Chinese Medicine Practitioner).

programme.title: 31看世界 - 地球大堡礁
programme.desc: Over the past 30 years, the world has lost nearly one-third of its coral reefs. More than one billion people depand on reefs for food and hunderds of thousands of people depend on them for their livelihoods. From the most recently developed killer robots to shellfish farming, ultra-modern tactics are now proving their worth in the Great Barrier Reef to ensure the survival of this natural wonder that is the coral world and to make it possible to export this know-how to many of the world’s reefs.

programme.title: 中華知識王2
programme.sub-title: 第四集 - 黃捷穎、馮皓揚、陳紫萱｜世代流傳建築技術智慧！
programme.desc: 第四集的星級嘉賓是黃捷穎Vinky 、演員馮皓揚和陳紫萱Summer。動靜皆宜的前國家跨欄運動員Vinky，帶來了自己繪畫的龍插畫作品與大家分享。環保、歷史地理、中國近代建設、文學、傳統文化及等等的題目包羅萬有，嘉賓們又能否一一解答？若然畫功好又能否佔盡優勢？一件歷史源遠流長的木製小玩意，居然蘊含中國古代建築技術的大智慧，以三位嘉賓的學識智慧又能否破解，最後成功取得中華知識王的美譽呢？. 主持：曾卓然、糖妹、阮頌陽. 嘉賓：黃捷穎、馮皓揚、陳紫萱. #中華知識王2 #曾卓然#糖妹#阮頌陽#黃捷穎#馮皓揚#陳紫萱#東北長白山#中國建築技術.

programme.title: 傷健同行好僱事
programme.desc: As one of the pillars of Hong Kong's economy, the retail industry has increasingly seen the presence of disabled employees in recent years. In the fiercely competitive retail market, it is easy to find heartwarming stories of compassion and commitment. . Gigi, the owner of a small chain of coffee shops, has insisted on hiring people with disabilities for over a decade. The brand currently operates four physical stores, with a small number of employees, half of whom are disabled. Among them are a deaf barista and a baker diagnosed with attention deficit disorder. Aside from focusing on their roles, Gigi has also arranged for them to work as sales staff at the stores and markets, training them to interact more with the public and practice skills in communication and management, hoping to make them more competitive in their future job searches. . Gigi often encourages and arranges for employees to participate in local and international hand-brewed coffee and baking competitions, aiming to lead them onto a broader stage beyond their small coffee retail store to expand their horizons. . Founded over twenty years ago, the social enterprise currently employs over 70% of its staff as mental health recoverers. The company operates various businesses, with retail being one of its main sectors. It includes its own brand store selling rehabilitation products and restaurants. . Recoverers who have suffered from schizophrenia , as well as employees with attention deficit disorder, work as convenience store staff and delivery personnel, with support and guidance from their families, supervisors, and social workers acting as their strongest backing. . In this episode, several individuals with disabilities striving in the retail industry overcome obstacles and bravely challenge themselves through their efforts in seeking employment and working. Today’s guest, Ng Hoi Yan, will experience firsthand the working conditions of disabled employees in the retail sector.

programme.title: 香港故事:尾巴會說話(英文版)
醫生與你 - 講飲講食講健康
programme.sub-title: #7 A Boon for Keeping Warm – Lamb
programme.desc: When talking about nourishing foods for the winter, lamb is often the first thing that comes to mind. Mutton is rich in protein and iron, making it highly beneficial for enriching the blood. However, as for the unique and strong “gamey smell” of mutton, some people love it while others find it off-putting. While we usually choose imported or Mainland mutton, black lambs are also bred in Hong Kong. In this episode, the “Food Fanatics” visit a farm where hundreds of black lambs are raised to explore their properties and habits. The chef host Mabel also creates a specially designed dish, “Crown Roast of Lamb with Lemon and Fermented Tofu, teaching us how to remove the gamey odor while preserving the tenderness of mutton. We also invited the news presenter Ruby LAM to share her tips for staying in shape; and the registered Chinese medicine practitioner CHO Shun-yan to explain the properties of lamb, including who should eat it and how to enjoy it in a nourishing way without causing "internal heat”. . Hosts: Yuki LAW, Mabel (Resident Chef). Guests: Ruby LAM, CHO Shun-yan (Registered Chinese Medicine Practitioner).
